Jennifer Garner Apple TV What\'s the plot? The last time we checked in on Hannah Hall (Garner), she was working at her art gallery when a heavily bearded man appeared, whom she immediately recognized as her missing husband, Owen ( Nikolaj Coster-Waldau ). He briefly touched her hand and whispered, "The could-have-been boys still love you," a callback to an earlier conversation about her exes. When Season 2 picks up, Hannah and her stepdaughter Bailey ( Angourie Rice ) find themselves in a terrifying race to figure out how to reunite their family before the past catches up to them. Who\'s in the cast? Garner, Coster-Waldau, and Rice are all back from Season 1, reprising their roles as three members of a dysfunctional family, as Hannah and Bailey are still searching for the missing Owen. Also returning is David Morse as Nicholas Bell, Owen\'s former father-in-law and Bailey\'s grandfather who has ties to the mafia. It\'s not yet known whether Victor Garber , Garner\'s Alias costar who popped up in Season 1 as Prof. Tobias Cookman, will return for the sequel. New additions to the cast for Season 2 include Rita Wilson , Judy Greer , Augusto Aguilera , Josh Hamilton , Nick Hargrove , Michael Galante , John Noble , Michael Hyatt , and Luke Kirby . What is the premiere date? Mark your calendar for Feb. 20, 2026, as that\'s when Season 2 will debut on Apple TV. That is almost three years after Season 1 launched on April 14, 2023. How many episodes? While the first season consisted of seven episodes, the upcoming season is slightly longer at eight episodes. Think of how much additional drama the writers can pack into that extra hour! First-look photos On Nov. 5, Apple TV released the first set of photos for Season 2 of The Last Thing He Told Me . The high-res images showcase Garner, Coster-Waldau, Rice, Wilson, and Greer. Eagle-eyed fans will notice the Eiffel Tower in the background of one of the pics, suggesting Garner\'s character will travel to Paris at some point. A video trailer will be unveiled at a later date. Apple TV \'s hit thriller The Last Thing He Told Me is returning for a second season, and judging by the newly released first-look pictures, it\'s shaping up to be the perfect new year binge. Based on The First Time I Saw Him – Laura Dave\'s sequel to her bestselling 2021 novel – the series will follow Hannah (Jennifer Garner) as she faces the shocking return of her missing husband five years after his mysterious disappearance. Jennifer Garner, who also serves as executive producer, stars alongside returning cast members Angourie Rice, David Morse and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau . © Courtesy of Apple You know you\'re in safe hands when a show comes from Reese Witherspoon\'s production company Hello Sunshine, and The Last Thing He Told Me is no exception. Known for championing female-written books, Hello Sunshine has delivered standout TV adaptations like Big Little Lies , Daisy Jones & the Six and The Morning Show . The first season was based on a Reese\'s Book Club pick that became an instant No. 1 New York Times bestseller – and with the sequel novel set to be released on 6 January, it\'s exciting to see Witherspoon and Garner bringing the next chapter to life. "I cannot wait to see how this story unfolds!!! Clearing my calendar to watch," one person commented, while another wrote: "Omg incredible stills!! Can\'t wait." A third penned: "Omg, I\'ve waited so long for this series. I\'m super excited." View post on Instagram © Courtesy of Apple What to expect from The Last Thing He Told Me season 2 Picking up in the aftermath of season one, the new chapter sees the shocking return of Hannah\'s long-lost husband, Owen. © Courtesy of Apple The synopsis reads: "When Owen (Coster-Waldau) shows up after five years on the run, Hannah (Garner) and her stepdaughter Bailey (Rice) find themselves in a race to figure out how to reunite their family before the past catches up to them." If you just can\'t wait for the show\'s premiere, audiences can read the "riveting and deeply moving" book, The First Time I Saw Him , when it\'s out on 6 January. © Courtesy of Apple Who joins the cast this season? Jennifer Garner ( 13 Going on 30 ) reprises her role as Hannah, with Nikolaj Coster-Waldau ( Game of Thrones ) returning as Owen, Angourie Rice ( Mean Girls ) as Bailey, and David Morse ( We Were Liars ) as Nicholas. © Courtesy of Apple The "gripping" second season also welcomes new and returning cast members including Judy Greer, Rita Wilson, Augusto Aguilera, Josh Hamilton, Nick Hargrove, Michael Galante, John Noble, Michael Hyatt and Luke Kirby. The Last Thing He Told Me season two lands on Apple TV on 20 January 2026. Based on the novel by Laura Dave , who developed the show with Josh Singer, The Last Thing He Told Me centers on Hannah Hall (Jennifer Garner) and her young stepdaughter after the mysterious disappearance of her husband. Debuting in April 2023 and consisting of seven episodes, the adaptation made a splash upon its premiere. It became Apple\'s most-watched limited series since the streaming service\'s debut in 2019, speeding up talks for The Last Thing He Told Me season 2. Apple reveals that The Last Thing He Told Me season 2 will premiere on Friday, February 20, 2026, and will consist of eight episodes. The photos, included below, reveal Garner\'s reunion with her 13 Going on 30 co-star Judy Greer. Based on the upcoming novel The First Time I Saw Him by Laura Dave, the upcoming episodes pick up as Hannah\'s husband, Owen (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau), returns after five years on the run. Hannah (Garner) and her stepdaughter Bailey (Angourie Rice) find themselves in a race, needing to figure out how to reunite their family before the past catches up to them. This picks up after the season 1 ending, which reveals that Owen is alive but in hiding. Along with Garner, Coster-Waldau, Rice, and Greer, The Last Thing He Told Me season 2 cast includes David Morse, Augusto Aguilera, Josh Hamilton, Nick Hargrove, Michael Galante, John Noble, Michael Hyatt, Luke Kirby, and Rita Wilson. Notable supporting actors from season 1, such as Criminal Minds star Aisha Tyler, are not mentioned, but they could potentially be making guest appearances. The Last Thing He Told Me is produced by 20th Television and Hello Sunshine, a part of Candle Media. It\'s executive produced by Dave, Singer, and Garner, as well as Hello Sunshine’s Reese Witherspoon and Lauren Neustadter. Daisy von Scherler Mayer and Merri D. Howard also serve as executive producers alongside new co-showrunner Aaron Zelman. The next chapter in the saga of the Apple TV series, which sees Garner returning as executive producer, will have to contend with a promise Owen made to stay away from Bailey. That is potentially complicated by his direct encounter with Hannah. But it\'ll also have to deal with making the jump from limited series to ongoing drama. The Last Thing He Told Me season 1 made some book changes to better fit the screen. It will have to make some more adjustments, with the hope that Hannah\'s story is one that viewers will still be invested in after a break of almost three years. Based on the talent involved, the interest will likely still be there even after the hiatus. Credit: Columbia/ Everett Thirty, flirty, and thriving (again)! 13 Going on 30 stars and longtime friends Jennifer Garner and Judy Greer are teaming up onscreen together once more in the upcoming season of Apple TV\'s The Last Thing He Told Me . In new first look images from the highly anticipated second season, Garner can be seen standing with her arms crossed overlooking a river in what looks like Paris as Greer approaches her from behind. Both women seem tense, though it\'s unclear what is bothering them. Jennifer Garner and Judy Greer in \'The Last Thing He Told Me\' season 2. Courtesy of Apple The actresses first appeared together in the beloved 2004 rom-com, also starring Mark Ruffalo, about a girl who wishes she were 30 on her 13th birthday, and wakes up to find it has come true and she is now living as an adult (Garner). Greer plays her childhood frenemy-turned-adult-friend (but actually still frenemy) Lucy. The other sneak peek images from The Last Thing He Told Me , which also seem to be mostly set in the City of Light, show Garner\'s Hannah with her arms around her stepdaughter, Bailey (Angourie Rice), as well as sitting at a cafe solo lost in thought, and receiving some wine from a new character played by Rita Wilson . Jennifer Garner and Angourie Rice in \'The Last Thing He Told Me\' season 2. Courtesy of Apple Jennifer Garner in \'The Last Thing He Told Me\' season 2. Courtesy of Apple Jennifer Garner and Rita Wilson in \'The Last Thing He Told Me\'. Courtesy of Apple Perhaps of most interest to fans of the series and the book upon which it\'s based, though, is a rather romantic picture that features Hannah and her long-lost husband, Owen ( Nikolaj Coster-Waldau ), talking on a balcony. Oh là là! Jennifer Garner and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau in \'The Last Thing He Told Me\' season 2. Courtesy of Apple \'The Last Thing He Told Me\' season 2 is a go at Apple TV+ How Enron inspired Laura Dave to write \'The Last Thing He Told Me\' Per a synopsis, this season of The Last Thing He Told Me picks up when Owen shows up after five years on the run, and Hannah and Bailey find themselves in a race to figure out how to reunite their family before the past catches up to them. The first season, which was based on Laura Dave\'s 2021 bestseller of the same name, was initially conceived as a limited series. Dave previously teased to Entertainment Weekly ahead of season 1\'s finale — which, like the book, somewhat controversially ends with Hannah deciding to live apart from her on-the-lam hubby for the sake of his daughter — that, if there ever were a book sequel, Owen\'s reasons for leaving the way he did "will become clear." "What I will say is, I had no intention of writing a sequel. I had no intention of it when I was writing the first one. It was closed for me," she said at the time. "Over time, and thinking about the way that readers have engaged so intensely with that last scene — in good and bad ways, people either love it or some people are like, \'How dare you not put them back together!\' — I\'ve been asked some questions around this in different capacities, and I started thinking about what the answers are. So now I don\'t know. I can imagine the world in which that sequel could come to be." Jennifer Garner in \'The Last Thing He Told Me\' season 2. Courtesy of Apple Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter . Dave, in fact, went on to write a sequel, dubbed The First Time I Saw Him , which will be available starting Jan. 6, 2026, ahead of the second season, which is based on the new book. Season 2 also welcomes new and returning cast David Morse, Augusto Aguilera, Josh Hamilton, Nick Hargrove, Michael Galante, John Noble, Michael Hyatt and Luke Kirby. The eight-episode second season will debut globally on Friday, Feb. 20, 2026 on Apple TV. EW\'s editorial guidelines November 3, 2025 9:00 a.m. ET 2 Comments Jonathan Bennett would never turn down a chance to return to the Mean Girls universe — yes, it\'s a multiverse, Tina Fey said so — but he would prefer that his iconic ladies man remain as such. "I think Aaron would be straight," Bennett tells host Tommy DiDario in Entertainment Weekly \'s exclusive preview of his upcoming appearance on the I\'ve Never Said This Before podcast, when the host questions if he would want Aaron Samuels to be depicted as gay in a potential sequel, considering his own sexuality. Bennett, who is over 20 years removed from playing the North Shore hottie who catches the eye of Lindsay Lohan \'s Cady Heron and Rachel McAdams \' Regina George, points out that "almost all the guys" who play the major characters in Mean Girls have come out as queer since the film\'s release, "which is just funny to me." Bennett, Daniel Franzese (who played Damian Leigh), and Rajiv Surendra (who played Kevin Gnapoor) were all closeted while making Mean Girls, and came out in 2017 , 2014 , and 2018 , respectively. Jonathan Bennett and Rachel McAdams in \'Mean Girls\'. Everett "I think Aaron would be straight because I wouldn\'t want to change the narrative of Aaron Samuels because Jonathan Bennett is gay. You would keep the narrative of Aaron Samuels because that\'s the story," he reasons. That\'s not to say that Bennett doesn\'t have ideas on what would happen should a sequel come to fruition. The Finding Mr. Christmas star acknowledges that no one has actually conceptualized the idea of a follow-up to the 2004 film, but says the desire to reprise their original roles is there for "99 percent of the cast." Bennett tells DiDario, "I don\'t think there\'s been an actual conversation between us that I can remember. But, like, in the group chat, do we want to do it? Yes. It\'s just, we did that movie 22 years ago, so it\'s like... everyone grows up. We were kids shooting this movie. And then you grow up and get your lives... So it\'s like, we would love to come back and bring the band back together. It\'s just way above my pay grade. That\'s a Tina Fey question." Rachel McAdams can\'t \'see a way to shoehorn\' OG \'Mean Girls\' stars into new movie Raven-Symoné reveals why she declined to have her \'Raven\'s Home\' character be a lesbian And if Fey gives a sequel the green light, Bennett shares that he believes his character would have become a teacher in the decades since the original film. "Why don\'t we just do the movie everyone wants; we all come back, I\'m a teacher at the school, the girls are grown up [and] have their own kids, and now their daughters are coming to school," Bennett suggests, adding that the film\'s plot would center on the parents\' of the kids in school as they\'re the former Mean Girls. "It\'s just in your face, like, that\'s the storyline. It\'s not rocket science." Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter . The actor quips that as someone that does Hallmark Channel movies, he thinks "a lot about multi-generational viewing," which would be a perfect way for both new and old fans of Mean Girls to enjoy a sequel. "You could have a storyline for all the parents who are the millennials that are fans of the movie [and] grew up with it; so they\'re going to be attached to, like Lacey, Amanda, me. And then you have the kids who are the new [stars] for their kids to be watching, so they can identify with those kids," Bennett pitches. DiDario jokes that Bennett is "such a producer," which the star takes on the chin, adding, "Tina, write [the movie]. I ain\'t getting any younger, sweetie." Christopher Briney as Aaron Samuels in \'Mean Girls (2024)\'. Jojo Whilden/Paramount Mean Girls — based on the 2002 book Queen Bees and Wannabes by Rosalind Wiseman — has become a modern classic, and inspired a Broadway musical that ran from 2017 to 2019, which laid the foundation for Fey\'s 2024 movie musical adaptation starring Angourie Rice in the role of Cady, with Reneé Rapp in the role of Regina. Bennett passed the torch of Aaron Samuels to The Summer I Turned Pretty star Christopher Briney for the film, who called the role a "dream." As for the possibility of a sequel that features the original stars, Fey previously said she tried to bring back all four actresses for the movie musical but "it didn\'t come together." "I have a feeling Paramount would love that. I have not really thought much about that," Fey told The New York Times in January 2024. "To me, part of why the stakes are so high in the story is because everyone\'s so young and feelings are huge, love is huge and friendship is huge in a way [that it isn\'t with] middle-aged moms. I love writing about middle-aged people, but I don\'t know." Watch the clip of Jonathan Bennett on the I\'ve Never Said This Before podcast above. The full episode drops on Tuesday. returns for its fourth season this May on HBO and will be available to stream on HBO Max. Emmy ® winner Uzo Aduba (“Mrs. America,” “Orange is the New Black”) will play the lead role of the therapist at the center of the season, as the observant, empathetic Dr. Brooke Taylor. The reimagining of the series is set in present-day Los Angeles and brings a diverse trio of patients in session with Brooke to help navigate a variety of modern concerns. Issues such as the global pandemic and recent major social and cultural shifts are a backdrop to the work Brooke will undertake — all while she deals with complications in her own personal life. IN TREATMENT also stars Anthony Ramos (“Hamilton”) as Eladio, who works as a home health aide for a wealthy family’s adult son; Liza Colón-Zayas (“David Makes Man”) as Rita, Brooke’s longtime confidant and friend who supports Brooke as she contends with her own demons after a life-altering loss; John Benjamin Hickey (“Jessica Jones”) as Colin, a charming millionaire beach bum turned white-collar criminal reckoning with all the ways his life has changed following his recent release from prison; Quintessa Swindell (“Euphoria”) as Laila, Brooke’s distrustful, teenage client, struggling to carve out her own identity separate from her family’s overbearing expectations; and Joel Kinnaman (“For All Mankind”) as Adam, Brooke’s long-time on-again, off-again boyfriend who has resurfaced to create further complexity for her. Martin and Lightbox, the production company founded by Academy Award-winning producer Simon Chinn and Emmy ® -winning producer Jonathan Chinn, together with Emmy-nominated producer Diane Becker, is a revealing and intimate look at the life and career of musical icon Tina Turner, charting her improbable rise to early fame, her personal and professional struggles throughout her life and her even more improbable resurgence as a global phenomenon in the 1980s. The documentary debuts SATURDAY, MARCH 27 (8:00 PM- 10:00 PM ET/PT) on HBO and will be available to stream on HBO Max. In spite of apparently having no budget, the taxpayer funded public broadcaster had plenty of star power on display, with Shaun Micallef and Tom Gleeson having the audience in stitches at times. Other stars on show included Anne Edmonds, John Safran, Triple J’s Abby Butler and Tyrone Pynor, Mark Fennel, Sam Pang and host more (B&T estimates half of the ABC studio was filled with talent an ABC execs). Guy Sebastian and Andrea Lam entertained guests with a liver performance towards the end. Micallef, given the unenviable task of introducing a new documentary about Rolf Harris, warned the ABC production team not to put a photo of Harris in the background while he was on stage, while Gleeson joked about how powerful men all seem to be middle aged bald white men, nodding to the ABC chair Kim Williams in the front row. Jokes aside, ABC reminded the audience that it is the most trusted media brand in Australia, and claimed ABC News is the top digital news and ABC iview is the number one BVOD service reaching 3.4 million Australians each week. ABC Radio reaches 4.751 million listeners each week across the 5 capital city markets and remains the number one digital streaming audio network. Furthermore, the ABC is the largest commissioner of Australian storytelling and its 2026 slate looks impressive. It is headlined by Goolagong , a mini-series about tennis star Evonne Goolagong; outback murder mystery Treasure & Dirt; a Tropic Noir series starring Anna Torv called Dustfall; and a return of the 90s creative competition series Race Around The World , which launched the career of Safran. There’s also that two-part Rolf Harris documentary which d elves into the sinister truth behind the performer; Shaun Micallef’s Going For Broke , a sober look at Australia’s lifelong love affair with gambling; and Ground Up , a comedy that follows the creation of the new Tasmanian AFL team – and the stadium that needs to be built first – starring Sam Pang. Marc Fennell’s provocative and deeply personal investigation into what it means to be a man in Australia today, The State of Man , looks like ‘must watch’ viewing, and the new comedy series Urzila , starring Urzila Carlson, will certainly find an audience. “The opportunity to lead the ABC is simultaneously both a huge privilege, but it also brings with it incredible responsibility,” ABC managing director Hugh Marks said. “No organisation even comes close to our beliefs and we contribute to our sense of Australians, our sense of identity through what is the most beautiful of things, story, news, audio and screen in all its forms. “We want Australians to feel the value of the ABC more than ever before, to see themselves in our stories and continue to trust us and be proud of what we deliver as we are.” An announcement that caught the eye was ABC’s commitment to storytelling via social media. It is launching ABC News Loop, which delivers format fit journalism directly to social media feed. ABC Media Showcase 2026 highlights SCREEN – SCRIPTED Based on the best-selling novel by Chris Hammer, Treasure & Dirt brings to life a gripping murder mystery set in a desolate outback opal town, starring Michael Dorman. Anna Torv leads Dustfall, based on the novel The Unbelieved by Vikki Petraitis, a gripping Tropic Noir about a detective investigating a string of drink spiking assaults. Powerful drama Shakedown brings to life the untold human stories behind one of the most shocking political scandals in Australian history. Premium mini-series Goolagong chronicles the life of world champion tennis player and Australian sporting hero Evonne Goolagong. Hilarious new comedy Ground Up follows the creation of the new Tasmanian AFL team – and the stadium that needs to be built first – starring Sam Pang. Heartwarming new series Dog Park, a feel-good story about finding belonging in a group of dog-owners; and beloved comedians Anne Edmonds and Kitty Flanagan unite for Bad Company, set within the crumbling walls of a theatre company on the brink of bankruptcy. Treasure & Dirt, starring Michael Dorman, brings to life a gripping murder mystery set in a desolate outback opal town. SCREEN – ENTERTAINMENT There’s loads more homegrown entertainment to look forward to, with Urzila taking us deep into the mind of comedy superstar, Urzila Carlson, through standup crafted together with hilarious sketches. A misfit crew of comedians return to the schoolyard in Class Clowns, where under the watchful eye of Principal Julia Morris, they tackle wildly ridiculous assignments based on classic school subjects. In Tonight at the Museum, host Alex Lee guides four celebrity contestants through games based around priceless objects from the Tasmanian Museum and Art Gallery. Always Was Tonight will decolonise news, one headline at a time. Hosted by Tony Armstrong and featuring a stellar cast of First Nations talent, this satire brings news with a bit more blaklash! Groundbreaking 90s creative competition series Race Around The World returns, this time with the effervescent Zan Rowe as host. Original provocateur John Safran also returns, this time to judge those who dare to follow in his Race footsteps. The Video, The Rumor, & The Truth By Author Simon Delott Published: Nov 09, 2025 at 8:39 AM • Category Zendaya Reading Time: 3 minutes Reading Time: 3 minutes Is Zendaya pregnant? Sometimes, rumors about Zendaya and Tom Holland are just wishful thinking. Or thirst. Or both. That said, sometimes these claims about the talented actress turn out to be true. It happens! So what about this time? Is Zendaya pregnant? Zendaya attends the Louis Vuitton Paris Womenswear Spring-Summer 2025 show as part of Paris Fashion Week on October 01, 2024. (Photo Credit: Pascal Le Segretain/Getty Images) Is Zendaya pregnant? In August of 2025, Zendaya appeared in an advertisement. She and Law Roach are part of a new ad campaign for On! It is good to remember that, though most of us know her first and foremost as an immensely talented actress, Zendaya is also a fashion icon. Zendaya and Law Roach for a new campaign with On! pic.twitter.com/aCUFmGXAoD — Zendaya Updates (@Zendaya_Updated) August 6, 2025 As you can see in this clip , however, which circulated around social media, Zendaya is wearing a puffy jacket. Now, there are plenty of reasons to wear a puffy jacket. They can be stylish. They can let you carry things in pockets. And some people, for whatever reason, feel “cold” in air conditioned buildings — even in the height of summer. Across social media, people have (once again) begun to speculate that Zendaya is pregnant and hiding a baby bump. Fans are jumping with presumptuous joy. And some thirsty individuals are lamenting that they missed a “chance” that they never had with her in the first place. Zendaya attends the 2024 Rock & Roll Hall Of Fame Induction Ceremony streaming on Disney+ at Rocket Mortgage Fieldhouse on October 19, 2024. (Photo Credit: Arturo Holmes/Getty Images for The Rock and Roll Hall of Fame) Wasn’t there similar speculation back in 2022? In June of 2022, a fan of Zendaya’s took to TikTok to spread pregnancy rumors about her. This claim soon spread to Twitter (this was before the platform’s cringe renaming). Just like now, many fans were excited for her and for hunky boyfriend Tom Holland. And many thirsty individuals wailed to the heavens that they’d missed out. It was a rare moment when Zendaya spoke up to quash the pregnancy rumor. In June 2022, Zendaya took to her Instagram Story to debunk a wild claim that she was pregnant. She blamed Twitter, though the rumor originated on TikTok. (Image Credit: Instagram) “See now, this is why I stay off Twitter,” Zendaya wrote on her Instagram Story at the time, erroneously blaming the wrong platform. “Just making stuff up for no reason … weekly” She is not entirely wrong. Many people do simply fabricate wild claims, or circulate dubious ones because it’s more exciting than waiting for the truth. People will also say things to sort of parody this trend. One common one? People declaring that Zendaya has impregnated Tom Holland. Sometimes, social media is a beautiful place. Zendaya stars in new campaign for On. [image or embed] — Film Updates ( @thefilmupdates.bsky.social ) August 7, 2025 at 7:27 AM Zendaya is Meechee, but she is not pregnant As we all know, Zendaya is many things. But there is no evidence at this time that she is pregnant. Furthermore, the video above — part of the exact same campaign as the earlier video with Law Roach — shows her wearing a body suit. If she has a baby bump, where exactly is she hiding it? If Zendaya — or, perhaps less likely, her fiance Tom Holland — were to become pregnant, we don’t know if or when she’d share the news. But she probably wouldn’t soft launch it in a fashion campaign in the middle of filming a new movie. The couple, who hard-launched their engagement at the Golden Globes this year, made a sweet appearance posing with fans on-set of Spider-Man: Brand New Day . Zendaya and Holland are also filming The Odyssey together. Despite hard-launching their engagement early this year, Zendaya and Tom Holland are still one of the most private couples in Hollywood. Their joint red carpet appearances are famously few and far between to keep their work from being overshadowed by their relationship—but fans can catch a rare glimpse of their love story on-set of the Spider-Man franchise , where their friendship first turned to romance. Case in point: On Friday, some lucky fans got a front-row seat to a rare Zendaya and Holland’s joint sighting as the couple posed for photos while filming Spider-Man: Brand New Day . In photos and videos shared on Instagram and X (formerly Twitter), Zendaya and her British fiancé could be seen taking a break from filming to pose with fans on-set on November 14. The Euphoria actress styled her natural curls in a middle-parted updo with face-framing tendrils, embracing a preppy look with a white collared shirt worn under a gray cardigan, black office-ready slacks, and a long black peacoat. A pair of black leather loafers finished off her outfit. Zendaya added a pop of color with her glam, pairing her glowing complexion and flushed cheeks with a matte rose-red lipstick. The superstar is reaching heavenly new heights with her next major acting role, in which she is set to star as one of the most well-known Greek goddesses. After a year of secrecy, Zendaya’s role in the upcoming epic The Odyssey has been unveiled, and the part also teases some screen time with her IRL fiancé Tom Holland . Zendaya was first announced as a cast member of Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey back in November 2024. At the time, her part was not revealed. But, new photos published in the Nov. 20 issue of Empire confirm that she will be portraying Athena, the goddess of wisdom. While not necessarily a main character in Homer’s Odyssey , Athena pops up at several critical moments in the ancient poem. She frequently appears as a guide for Odysseus and his son, Telemachus. Most notably, it is Athena who encourages Telemachus to seek out news of his father at the beginning of the story, acting as a catalyst for most of the action. This is another layer of what makes Zendaya’s casting as Athena so exciting — the role of Telemachus is being played by Holland. While no, Athena and Telemachus don’t have a romantic relationship like the engaged actors do , the casting does mean that Zendaya and Holland will likely share some scenes together in The Odyssey . Eric Charbonneau/Getty Images Entertainment/Getty Images Of couse, this isn’t the first time that Zendaya and Holland have shared the screen. The couple has been showing off their love in the Spider-Man movies since 2017. The new Empire photos also confirmed a couple other mysterious roles in The Odyssey — Robert Pattinson has been revealed to be playing Antinous, one of Penelope’s suitors, and John Leguizamo will play Odysseus’ servant Eumaeus. The rest of the movie’s star-studded cast includes Matt Damon as Odysseus, Anne Hathaway as Penelope, Charlize Theron as Circe, Jon Bernthal as Menelaus, and Mia Goth as Melantho. There are various other buzzy actors who have been cast in undisclosed roles, such as: Lupita Nyong’o, Elliot Page, and Benny Safdie. The Odyssey will sail into theaters on July 17, 2026. By Author Simon Delott Published: Nov 12, 2025 at 1:07 PM • Category Sydney Sweeney Reading Time: 4 minutes Reading Time: 4 minutes Is Zendaya refusing to do Euphoria press with Sydney Sweeney? These two talented actresses have known and worked with each other for years on the HBO hit. However, after Sweeney’s months of controversies (which may have contributed to a theatrical flop), is her brand too toxic? A new report says that Zendaya worries about just that as their hit series is poised to return for Season 3. Actresses Barbie Ferreira, Zendaya, Sydney Sweeney, and Alexa Demie attend the Los Angeles premiere of the new HBO series “Euphoria” on June 4, 2019. (Photo Credit: CHRIS DELMAS/AFP via Getty Images) Is Zendaya refusing to do press with Sydney Sweeney? On Tuesday, November 11, The Daily Mail reported that Zendaya is refusing to do press with Sydney Sweeney. Next year, Euphoria Season 3 will (finally) come out. As is the case with most shows, the HBO drama will require promotional work by much of the cast. And Zendaya, Sweeney, and co-star Hunter Schafer are undoubtedly the most famous women on the list. Zendaya’s reasons for avoiding Sweeney, according to the report, include the latter’s status as symbolic darling of Donald Trump’s MAGA supporters following her jeans ad controversy — and her refusal to disavow these people. Zendaya attends the Gothams 34th Annual Film Awards at Cipriani Wall Street on December 02, 2024. (Photo Credit: Mike Coppola/Getty Images for The Gotham Film & Media Institute) “It’s no wonder she’s refusing to do it,” an inside source commented to The Daily Mail. “It’s a difficult position for Zendaya to be in,” the insider reasoned. The source explained that it’s challenging “because if she even stands next to Sydney on the red carpet, it can be read as her excusing Sydney’s views on Trump and her refusal to apologize for the racist ad.” That is to say that it doesn’t have to be personal animosity behind the reported reluctance to appear at the same events. When one person’s brand becomes linked to a cognitively impaired authoritarian with credible implications of involvement in the world’s most notorious pedophile’s crimes, the bad press can rub off onto others. Actress Sydney Sweeney attends the Academy Museum Gala at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures in Los Angeles on October 18, 2025. (Photo Credit: VALERIE MACON/AFP via Getty Images) 2025 has not been her year This summer, Zendaya was clearly not the only person to notice that Sydney Sweeney had a bit of controversy. The entire world took note. It began with a controversial American Eagle jeans ad in which Sweeney posed seductively while the ad quipped about her “good jeans.” The last bit was a deliberate pun about genetics … which sounded an awful lot like a eugenics dogwhistle . It didn’t have to be a big deal. If there had been hasty apologies, it could have blown over instantly. But there weren’t. Perhaps because of the lack of apology and the sheer number of white nationalists running the US federal government right now, people were not up to giving Sweeney or American Eagle the benefit of the doubt. Zendaya attends the 82nd Annual Golden Globe Awards at The Beverly Hilton on January 05, 2025. (Photo Credit: Amy Sussman/Getty Images) According to Sweeney, she was simply too busy filming Euphoria to react to the controversy. Not the best PR move, to be sure, but that’s fair. But when the worst people alive praised Sweeney and the ad and when reports came out saying that she registered (years ago) as a Republican, the pressure to disavow Trump and white nationalism grew. Remember, not only are many of Sweeney’s fans targets of the Trump regime, but so are her coworkers — including Schafer, as we reported earlier this year. There are controversies where a public figure would be wiser to avoid speaking out and letting it blow over. But when it doesn’t blow over, staying quiet is the wrong call. Actress Sydney Sweeney attends the cast Of “Christy” appear on SiriusXM’s The Julia Cunningham Show at SiriusXM Studios on October 28, 2025. (Photo Credit: Vivien Killilea/Getty Images for SiriusXM) Is Sydney Sweeney a bad person? It is always possible that a public figure — no matter how skilled, no matter how famously beautiful — might be a bad person. Some actively hide their malice with positive contributions to political and philanthropic causes. Others simply mask their malevolence with silence. But not everyone who is silent on a topic (no matter how important) is staying quiet because they are evil. Sometimes, they just don’t feel that they know enough about a subject to properly weigh in. Other times, they’re just afraid of what feels like a no-win scenario. And that, we think , is where Zendaya and Sydney Sweeney differ in their PR strategies. Sweeney likely fears that speaking out will have a bunch of people hating her, so she opts for silence. Zendaya faces rumors without weighing in. But she is outspoken on matters of grave importance, like Trump’s campaign of terror against the American people. We of course cannot verify whether Zendaya will actually decline to walk the red carpet with Sweeney. He's visited children's hospitals twice, once in Atlanta during 'Homecoming' filming and again in Los Angeles with Zendaya and Jake Gyllenhaal for a 'Far From Home' screening. Holland even performed stunts for young patients, showcasing his dedication to inspiring them. There are only a handful of heroes who continue to inspire the humanitarians, despite not wearing any capes. Tom Holland is one of them; he might have had web shooters in the fictional multiverse, but his efforts prosper in real life. The 29-year-old wore his Spidey suit and visited children’s hospitals (not once but twice). Tom Holland visited the children's hospital Tom Holland has discussed his health issues with the media, and that doesn’t stop him from meeting the young ones. In mid-2016, the British actor made a visit to Egleston Children's Hospital in Atlanta, when the Homecoming film was still in production. “Meeting you all today was such a wonderful experience and you're all such little inspirations. We're proud of you and we love and we hope to be back soon ❤️ and thank you for having us,” he wrote in his Instagram caption, with a candid picture of him smiling with a little boy. Zendaya and Jake Gyllenhaal joined Tom Holland As time passed, Tom Holland visited the children’s hospital once again. However, this time it was with Zendaya and Jake Gyllenhaal in Los Angeles. The three stars visited in mid-2019, where the young patients and their parents watched the special advanced screening of the then-upcoming film ‘Far From Home.’ Moreover, they interacted with the young ones, while Holland performed a couple of stunts for his fans. “We wanted them to be the first people here on the West Coast to see it. This is going to be really fun,” he said in the hospital vlog, where he was in his new suit, Zendaya dressed as MJ, and Gyllenhaal donned his Mysterio suit. After signing posters and appreciating cool t-shirts, Holland introduced Jake’s character, “Hey man, I’m Spider-Man. So, I fight the bad guys, and so does Mysterio, we team up to fight the bad guys together so we keep everybody safe. ” ' Spider-Man: Brand New Day ' When a boy revealed that he likes Spider-Man because he shoots his webs, Tom said, “I actually used all my webs on the way over here,” with a darling smile. As of now, Tom and Zendaya are looking forward to the fourth film of the franchise, ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day,’ which will be released on July 31, 2026. MJ) in Spider-Man: Brand New Day will be bigger than expected... News By JoshWilding - Nov 05, 2025 06:11 AM EST Filed Under: Spider-Man: Brand New Day While we know that Zendaya will reprise her role as MJ in next summer\'s Spider-Man: Brand New Day , there have been contradictory reports about how big a role she\'ll play in the movie. At the end of Spider-Man: No Way Home , Doctor Strange\'s spell meant that Michelle forgot Peter Parker. However, when he crossed paths with her again in the movie\'s closing moments, there was a glimmer of recognition, suggesting their love might trump the spell that saved Earth-616. Now, there\'s speculation that Zendaya\'s role in Spider-Man: Brand New Day will be bigger than expected. Her stylist, Law Roach, has revealed in a red carpet interview that he\'s already preparing outfits for the actress to wear on the movie\'s press tour. Someone with a glorified cameo likely wouldn\'t need to make red carpet appearances. While Zendaya may be there to support fiancé Tom Holland, this does seem to imply that she\'ll have a substantial role in the next Spider-Man movie. She\'s already been spotted on set alongside Holland as Peter Parker visited Aunt May\'s grave, leading to theories that we\'ll see MJ regain her memories of who is beneath Spider-Man\'s mask during this street-level adventure. Jacob Batalon is also confirmed to reprise his role as Ned, while it was recently rumoured that Tony Revolori is returning as Flash Thompson (a hint perhaps that we\'ll pay a visit to MIT). It\'s not clear whether we\'ll see other familiar faces, such as Betty Brant and J. Jonah Jameson. "I read it three weeks ago, and it really lit a fire in me," Holland said of Spider-Man: Brand New Day last year. "Zendaya and I sat down and read it together, and we at times were bouncing around the living room like, ‘This is a real movie worthy of the fans’ respect.’ But there’s a few things we need to figure out before we can get that really going, but it’s exciting." You can hear more from Roach in the player below. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Entertainment Tonight (@entertainmenttonight) Spider-Man: Brand New Day shares a title with a divisive era of storytelling, which, thanks to a deal with Mephisto, saw the wall-crawler get a fresh start when his marriage to Mary Jane Watson ended and his identity became secret again. He faced many new sinister foes during that time and was surrounded by a fresh supporting cast, including Mister Negative, Jackpot, Menace, and Carlie Cooper. In the MCU, all signs point to Spidey teaming up with (and at some point fighting) The Punisher to take on a Savage Hulk, with The Scorpion thrown in for good measure. Several other villains are reportedly set to appear in the movie, including Tombstone, Tarantula, Boomerang, and Ramrod. There\'s also been some chatter online about the Symbiote factoring into the story, potentially setting the stage for Mac Gargan to don the alien costume as Venom. Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings helmer Destin Daniel Cretton directs Spider-Man: Brand New Day from a script by Chris McKenna and Erik Sommers. Tom Holland plays Spider-Man in a cast that also includes Jon Bernthal (The Punisher), Mark Ruffalo (The Hulk), Zendaya (MJ), Sadie Sink, Michael Mando (The Scorpion), Tramell Tillman, Marvin Jones III (Tombstone), Jacob Batalon (Ned Leeds), and Liza Colón-Zayas. Thunderbolts* star Florence Pugh is expected to return as Yelena Belova. Spider-Man: Brand New Day will be released in theaters on July 31, 2026. So when the Zendaya capsule dropped, I figured: If I’m going to give On a proper first go, I want to do it with a collection that clearly leans into both fashion and performance. There’s no doubt these pieces look great. The collection is full of sleek-looking sneakers, jackets, and bottoms in a variety of chic colors and flattering silhouettes. But part of my job is asking: Does this item really perform? Or is it just great street style? I put three pieces through their paces—from HIIT workouts to all-day errands—to find out. Shop The Zendaya x On Collection What I Tested I tested the Cloudzone Moon sneakers in Black/Dew, the Track Shorts in Cream, and the Track Jacket in Cream. Over three weeks of walking, light training, errand-running, and styling for casual outings, I looked at how they felt on the body, how they held up, and how they looked when styled in my regular rotation. Each item gets its own mini-review next. On x Zendaya Cloudzone Moon Review On Cloudzone Moon $200 at on.com Credit: On Pros Sleek look Breathable Supportive Cons Not super plush or cushioned This sneaker was the first item I put to the test from the collection (and from On as a whole!), so my expectations were high. Right out of the box, I was immediately impressed with how stylish the shoe looked. I’m not a huge fan of black sneakers, but I found this shoe really easy to style with a lot of my existing wardrobe. It's super sleek with a low-profile look that looks great with a pair of crew socks and leggings or shorts. I personally love pairing mine with the below track jacket and short set, and a black tank top underneath. While they are undeniably stylish, they don’t skimp on support either. The midsole feels really stable, and for a low-profile shoe, my foot feels surprisingly locked in on long walks and runs. That’s likely due to On’s Speedboard technology, a thermoplastic sole that is equally stiff and flexible. That said, if you’re a fan of the Swiss brand’s cloud-like cushioning, these might not fully deliver on that ultra-plush feel. This sort of threw me at first, given the name of the shoe. They’re more structured than they are squishy, which works beautifully for walking and training—but less so if you’re chasing that marshmallow-soft ride. Shannen Zitz Shannen wearing the Cloudzone Moon in Black/Dew. On x Zendaya Track Short Review On Track Shorts $110 at on.com Credit: On Pros Lightweight and breathable High-quality seams and zippers Adjustable waistband Cons Run long This track short feels super lightweight, like you’re literally wearing air. But the quality construction and attention to detail give it an upgraded, tailored vibe. The adjustable waistband is a major win, and you can tell from the stitching alone that this short was made to last far beyond a single season. I’ve already worn and washed it a handful of times, and it looks just as good as when it arrived at my doorstep. It looks super stylish paired with a monochrome fit (like with the matching jacket, a cream-colored t-shirt, and tan sneakers), but also works with just about any color in my closet. My only gripe? This short runs a little long on me, which takes away some of that fast feel I want in a running short. I might get it hemmed just to hit the perfect length—but that’s an easy fix for a pair that ticks so many other boxes. Whether I’m running laps or running errands, it strikes the perfect balance between performance-grade gear and streetwear cool. Shannen Zitz Shannen wearing the Track Short in Cream, styled with the Track Jacket and Cloudzone Moon. On x Zendaya Track Jacket Review On Track Jacket $180 at on.com Credit: On Pros Roomy, boxy fit Lightweight and breathable Clean, streamlined look Cons Not super warm Like the track short, its matching jacket is feather light and slightly boxy for an effortless vibe. The material feels premium, and the construction is top-tier with zippers that blend right into the fabric and a slightly funnel-shaped collar that looks super chic when zipped all the way shut. It’s the kind of jacket that instantly pulls a look together, even if you’re just layering it over a tank top and leggings. Just don’t expect it to be your warmest layer. It’s designed for movement, not warmth, which makes it ideal for toasty fall afternoons or warming up before a workout. Still, it’s so stylish and versatile that I wear it under my winter coat when temps drop. If Zendaya’s goal was to make performance wear that belongs both in the gym and on the street, this jacket might be the collection's ultimate proof. Shannen Zitz Track Jacket The Final Verdict: Should You Shop The Collection? After testing the On x Zendaya collection , I get the hype. You can totally tell that this collection was designed with the help of Zendaya and stylist Law Roach. It’s a rare activewear line that feels both high-fashion and high-performance. The materials and construction live up to On’s technical reputation, while Zendaya’s style shines through in the line’s sleek silhouettes and flattering color schemes. I love wearing these pieces while I’m breaking a sweat, and feel just as comfortable meeting up for a post-workout lunch without bringing a change of clothes. If you’re after gear that performs as well as it photographs, this collection can’t be missed. The rift centers on contrasting political viewpoints rather than any personal conflict. Sweeney, 28, has openly identified as a Republican and vocal supporter of President Donald Trump, while Zendaya, 29, has consistently opposed Trump’s political positions. The ideological gap between the two has created an awkward dynamic as they face the prospect of appearing together for press appearances and red carpet events tied to Euphoria’s next chapter. The advertising controversy The tension intensified following Sweeney’s appearance in an American Eagle jeans campaign that drew swift backlash on social media. Critics alleged the advertisement contained a racist undertone through a wordplay pun linking jeans with genes. The ad featured a line reading Sydney Sweeney has great jeans, which observers interpreted as a clever double meaning that some deemed offensive and inappropriate. When confronted about the controversial campaign, Sweeney declined to apologize for her participation or the ad’s messaging. In an interview with GQ, the actress maintained that she was fully aware of the implications surrounding the project. She stated that the advertisement spoke for itself and that the social media reaction caught her off guard. Sweeney suggested that when she chooses to address issues directly, her voice will be heard through deliberate statements rather than responses to criticism. Growing distance for season three The political and advertising-related tensions have created complications for Euphoria’s upcoming promotional cycle. Reports indicate that Zendaya has been reluctant to participate in joint press obligations with Sweeney, particularly those involving red carpet appearances or shared interviews. This development carries significant implications for HBO’s marketing strategy surrounding the show’s third season, which wrapped production several weeks ago. Sources familiar with the situation explained that the dynamic puts Zendaya in a difficult position. Being photographed alongside Sweeney on the red carpet could be interpreted by observers and media as tacit endorsement of Sweeney’s political views or her refusal to address the American Eagle advertisement controversy. The perception challenge looms large as promotional efforts ramp up ahead of the new season’s premiere. History of closeness The two actresses previously shared a strong professional rapport during Euphoria’s run. Sweeney regularly referred to Zendaya affectionately as Z during interviews and public appearances, suggesting genuine warmth between the cast members. Their chemistry on screen and evident friendship off camera contributed to the show’s compelling dynamics and backstage camaraderie that fans often celebrated online. That personal connection now appears strained by circumstances neither actress has publicly acknowledged or addressed. The friendship that once seemed unshakeable has developed visible cracks as external pressures and differing worldviews create complications for their professional relationship. Zendaya’s political stance Zendaya has maintained a consistent political record independent of current events. The actress previously vocalized opposition to Trump’s presidency, even posting directly to social media in 2020 encouraging her followers to vote him out of office. Her political engagement demonstrates a long-standing commitment to her stated values, making any appearance of solidarity with Sweeney particularly fraught with potential misinterpretation. The contrast between the two actresses’ public political records makes joint promotional activities inherently complicated. What might normally be routine press work has become laden with subtext and potential meaning beyond the scope of television promotion. Waiting for clarification Neither Sweeney nor Zendaya has officially commented on the status of their friendship or the accuracy of reported tensions between them. Without direct statements from either actress, the full context of their relationship remains unclear. Industry insiders and entertainment observers will likely be watching closely to see how HBO and the show’s producers navigate promotional requirements that involve both actresses working in proximity. The third season of Euphoria holds significant commercial importance for HBO, and managing the public dynamics between two leads with opposing political views presents genuine logistical and public relations challenges. How the situation ultimately resolves—whether through reconciliation, separate promotional schedules, or direct acknowledgment—may reveal much about both actresses’ commitment to their professional obligations and personal convictions heading into the new year. Large Christopher Nolan\'s \'The Odyssey\' is igniting fan excitement with first-look images of Robert Pattinson, Zendaya, and John Leguizamo. Matt Damon stars as Odysseus in this fantasy-action reimagining of Homer\'s epic. The star-studded cast, including Anne Hathaway and Tom Holland, promises a grand cinematic spectacle as Odysseus battles monsters and fate on his journey home after the Trojan War. Christopher Nolan only needs a whisper to set the internet vibrating, but the first look at The Odyssey has pushed that buzz into full-blown frenzy. The images, our first glimpse of Robert Pattinson , Zendaya , and John Leguizamo in character, dropped via Empire and instantly lit up social feeds. The director is reimagining Homer’s epic as a fantasy-action odyssey, a scale he’s more than comfortable with, with Matt Damon leading the charge as Odysseus, the war-worn king of Ithaca fighting his way back home. But the new images belong to Pattinson, Zendaya, and Leguizamo, who each take on roles woven deep into the mythology. Pattinson appears as Antinous, the powerful suitor vying for Penelope in Odysseus’s absence. Zendaya steps into the divine as Athena, the goddess of wisdom and war. And Leguizamo plays Eumaeus, the steadfast servant who becomes one of Odysseus’s most loyal allies. And it doesn’t stop there. The cast list reads like a cross-section of Hollywood heavyweights: Tom Holland as Telemachus, Anne Hathaway as Penelope, Charlize Theron as Circe, Benny Safdie as Agamemnon, Lupita Nyong’o as Clytemnestra. Add Elliot Page, Mia Goth, Corey Hawkins, Jon Bernthal, Cosmo Jarvis, Himesh Patel, Samantha Morton, Will Yun Lee, Logan Marshall-Green, James Remar, and more, and it becomes clear Nolan is assembling something closer to a cinematic army than a simple ensemble. Universal’s official synopsis keeps it classic: Odysseus’ long journey home after the Trojan War, marked by monsters, temptations, and the raw brutality of fate. Cyclopes, Sirens, Circe — all the touchstones are there. But with Nolan at the helm, audiences are already imagining how those mythic clashes will be built, staged, and grounded. Social media, predictably, is already treating the film like an event years before its release. One user on social media wrote, "GIVE IT TO ME NOWWWWWWWW." After a year of secrecy, Zendaya’s role in the upcoming epic The Odyssey has been unveiled, and the part also teases some screen time with her IRL fiancé Tom Holland . Zendaya was first announced as a cast member of Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey back in November 2024. At the time, her part was not revealed. But, new photos published in the Nov. 20 issue of Empire confirm that she will be portraying Athena, the goddess of wisdom. While not necessarily a main character in Homer’s Odyssey , Athena pops up at several critical moments in the ancient poem. She frequently appears as a guide for Odysseus and his son, Telemachus. Most notably, it is Athena who encourages Telemachus to seek out news of his father at the beginning of the story, acting as a catalyst for most of the action. This is another layer of what makes Zendaya’s casting as Athena so exciting — the role of Telemachus is being played by Holland. While no, Athena and Telemachus don’t have a romantic relationship like the engaged actors do , the casting does mean that Zendaya and Holland will likely share some scenes together in The Odyssey . Eric Charbonneau/Getty Images Entertainment/Getty Images Of couse, this isn’t the first time that Zendaya and Holland have shared the screen. The couple has been showing off their love in the Spider-Man movies since 2017. The new Empire photos also confirmed a couple other mysterious roles in The Odyssey — Robert Pattinson has been revealed to be playing Antinous, one of Penelope’s suitors, and John Leguizamo will play Odysseus’ servant Eumaeus. The rest of the movie’s star-studded cast includes Matt Damon as Odysseus, Anne Hathaway as Penelope, Charlize Theron as Circe, Jon Bernthal as Menelaus, and Mia Goth as Melantho. There are various other buzzy actors who have been cast in undisclosed roles, such as: Lupita Nyong’o, Elliot Page, and Benny Safdie. The Odyssey will sail into theaters on July 17, 2026. By Author Simon Delott Published: Nov 12, 2025 at 1:07 PM • Category Sydney Sweeney Reading Time: 4 minutes Reading Time: 4 minutes Is Zendaya refusing to do Euphoria press with Sydney Sweeney? These two talented actresses have known and worked with each other for years on the HBO hit. However, after Sweeney’s months of controversies (which may have contributed to a theatrical flop), is her brand too toxic? A new report says that Zendaya worries about just that as their hit series is poised to return for Season 3. Actresses Barbie Ferreira, Zendaya, Sydney Sweeney, and Alexa Demie attend the Los Angeles premiere of the new HBO series “Euphoria” on June 4, 2019. (Photo Credit: CHRIS DELMAS/AFP via Getty Images) Is Zendaya refusing to do press with Sydney Sweeney? On Tuesday, November 11, The Daily Mail reported that Zendaya is refusing to do press with Sydney Sweeney. Next year, Euphoria Season 3 will (finally) come out. As is the case with most shows, the HBO drama will require promotional work by much of the cast. And Zendaya, Sweeney, and co-star Hunter Schafer are undoubtedly the most famous women on the list. Zendaya’s reasons for avoiding Sweeney, according to the report, include the latter’s status as symbolic darling of Donald Trump’s MAGA supporters following her jeans ad controversy — and her refusal to disavow these people. Zendaya attends the Gothams 34th Annual Film Awards at Cipriani Wall Street on December 02, 2024. (Photo Credit: Mike Coppola/Getty Images for The Gotham Film & Media Institute) “It’s no wonder she’s refusing to do it,” an inside source commented to The Daily Mail. “It’s a difficult position for Zendaya to be in,” the insider reasoned. The source explained that it’s challenging “because if she even stands next to Sydney on the red carpet, it can be read as her excusing Sydney’s views on Trump and her refusal to apologize for the racist ad.” That is to say that it doesn’t have to be personal animosity behind the reported reluctance to appear at the same events. When one person’s brand becomes linked to a cognitively impaired authoritarian with credible implications of involvement in the world’s most notorious pedophile’s crimes, the bad press can rub off onto others. Actress Sydney Sweeney attends the Academy Museum Gala at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures in Los Angeles on October 18, 2025. (Photo Credit: VALERIE MACON/AFP via Getty Images) 2025 has not been her year This summer, Zendaya was clearly not the only person to notice that Sydney Sweeney had a bit of controversy. The entire world took note. It began with a controversial American Eagle jeans ad in which Sweeney posed seductively while the ad quipped about her “good jeans.” The last bit was a deliberate pun about genetics … which sounded an awful lot like a eugenics dogwhistle . It didn’t have to be a big deal. If there had been hasty apologies, it could have blown over instantly. But there weren’t. Perhaps because of the lack of apology and the sheer number of white nationalists running the US federal government right now, people were not up to giving Sweeney or American Eagle the benefit of the doubt. Zendaya attends the 82nd Annual Golden Globe Awards at The Beverly Hilton on January 05, 2025. (Photo Credit: Amy Sussman/Getty Images) According to Sweeney, she was simply too busy filming Euphoria to react to the controversy. Not the best PR move, to be sure, but that’s fair. But when the worst people alive praised Sweeney and the ad and when reports came out saying that she registered (years ago) as a Republican, the pressure to disavow Trump and white nationalism grew. Remember, not only are many of Sweeney’s fans targets of the Trump regime, but so are her coworkers — including Schafer, as we reported earlier this year. There are controversies where a public figure would be wiser to avoid speaking out and letting it blow over. But when it doesn’t blow over, staying quiet is the wrong call. Actress Sydney Sweeney attends the cast Of “Christy” appear on SiriusXM’s The Julia Cunningham Show at SiriusXM Studios on October 28, 2025. (Photo Credit: Vivien Killilea/Getty Images for SiriusXM) Is Sydney Sweeney a bad person? It is always possible that a public figure — no matter how skilled, no matter how famously beautiful — might be a bad person. Some actively hide their malice with positive contributions to political and philanthropic causes. Others simply mask their malevolence with silence. But not everyone who is silent on a topic (no matter how important) is staying quiet because they are evil. Sometimes, they just don’t feel that they know enough about a subject to properly weigh in. Other times, they’re just afraid of what feels like a no-win scenario. And that, we think , is where Zendaya and Sydney Sweeney differ in their PR strategies. Sweeney likely fears that speaking out will have a bunch of people hating her, so she opts for silence. Zendaya faces rumors without weighing in. But she is outspoken on matters of grave importance, like Trump’s campaign of terror against the American people. We of course cannot verify whether Zendaya will actually decline to walk the red carpet with Sweeney. No matter what, we hope that Sweeney will consider that having a bunch of bad people mad at her would not be as bad as having a bunch of good people mad at her. He's visited children's hospitals twice, once in Atlanta during 'Homecoming' filming and again in Los Angeles with Zendaya and Jake Gyllenhaal for a 'Far From Home' screening. Holland even performed stunts for young patients, showcasing his dedication to inspiring them. There are only a handful of heroes who continue to inspire the humanitarians, despite not wearing any capes. Tom Holland is one of them; he might have had web shooters in the fictional multiverse, but his efforts prosper in real life. The 29-year-old wore his Spidey suit and visited children’s hospitals (not once but twice). Tom Holland visited the children's hospital Tom Holland has discussed his health issues with the media, and that doesn’t stop him from meeting the young ones. In mid-2016, the British actor made a visit to Egleston Children's Hospital in Atlanta, when the Homecoming film was still in production. “Meeting you all today was such a wonderful experience and you're all such little inspirations. We're proud of you and we love and we hope to be back soon ❤️ and thank you for having us,” he wrote in his Instagram caption, with a candid picture of him smiling with a little boy. Zendaya and Jake Gyllenhaal joined Tom Holland As time passed, Tom Holland visited the children’s hospital once again. However, this time it was with Zendaya and Jake Gyllenhaal in Los Angeles. The three stars visited in mid-2019, where the young patients and their parents watched the special advanced screening of the then-upcoming film ‘Far From Home.’ Moreover, they interacted with the young ones, while Holland performed a couple of stunts for his fans. “We wanted them to be the first people here on the West Coast to see it. This is going to be really fun,” he said in the hospital vlog, where he was in his new suit, Zendaya dressed as MJ, and Gyllenhaal donned his Mysterio suit. After signing posters and appreciating cool t-shirts, Holland introduced Jake’s character, “Hey man, I’m Spider-Man. So, I fight the bad guys, and so does Mysterio, we team up to fight the bad guys together so we keep everybody safe. ” ' Spider-Man: Brand New Day ' When a boy revealed that he likes Spider-Man because he shoots his webs, Tom said, “I actually used all my webs on the way over here,” with a darling smile. As of now, Tom and Zendaya are looking forward to the fourth film of the franchise, ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day,’ which will be released on July 31, 2026. By Shannen Zitz Published: Oct 28, 2025 4:27 PM EDT Reviewed by Christian Gollayan Deputy Editor, Commerce View Products Women's Health may earn commission from the links on this page, but we only feature products we believe in. Why Trust Us? I’m a style editor who lives and breathes activewear—and have a closet full of Vuori , lululemon , and Alo Yoga to prove it. But honestly, I’m a little late to the game when it comes to On (despite On running shoes being a total WH editor favorite). So when the Zendaya capsule dropped, I figured: If I’m going to give On a proper first go, I want to do it with a collection that clearly leans into both fashion and performance. There’s no doubt these pieces look great. The collection is full of sleek-looking sneakers, jackets, and bottoms in a variety of chic colors and flattering silhouettes. But part of my job is asking: Does this item really perform? Or is it just great street style? I put three pieces through their paces—from HIIT workouts to all-day errands—to find out. Shop The Zendaya x On Collection What I Tested I tested the Cloudzone Moon sneakers in Black/Dew, the Track Shorts in Cream, and the Track Jacket in Cream. Over three weeks of walking, light training, errand-running, and styling for casual outings, I looked at how they felt on the body, how they held up, and how they looked when styled in my regular rotation. Each item gets its own mini-review next. On x Zendaya Cloudzone Moon Review On Cloudzone Moon $200 at on.com Credit: On Pros Sleek look Breathable Supportive Cons Not super plush or cushioned This sneaker was the first item I put to the test from the collection (and from On as a whole!), so my expectations were high. Right out of the box, I was immediately impressed with how stylish the shoe looked. I’m not a huge fan of black sneakers, but I found this shoe really easy to style with a lot of my existing wardrobe. It's super sleek with a low-profile look that looks great with a pair of crew socks and leggings or shorts. I personally love pairing mine with the below track jacket and short set, and a black tank top underneath. While they are undeniably stylish, they don’t skimp on support either. The midsole feels really stable, and for a low-profile shoe, my foot feels surprisingly locked in on long walks and runs. That’s likely due to On’s Speedboard technology, a thermoplastic sole that is equally stiff and flexible. That said, if you’re a fan of the Swiss brand’s cloud-like cushioning, these might not fully deliver on that ultra-plush feel. This sort of threw me at first, given the name of the shoe. They’re more structured than they are squishy, which works beautifully for walking and training—but less so if you’re chasing that marshmallow-soft ride. Shannen Zitz Shannen wearing the Cloudzone Moon in Black/Dew. On x Zendaya Track Short Review On Track Shorts $110 at on.com Credit: On Pros Lightweight and breathable High-quality seams and zippers Adjustable waistband Cons Run long This track short feels super lightweight, like you’re literally wearing air. But the quality construction and attention to detail give it an upgraded, tailored vibe. The adjustable waistband is a major win, and you can tell from the stitching alone that this short was made to last far beyond a single season. I’ve already worn and washed it a handful of times, and it looks just as good as when it arrived at my doorstep. It looks super stylish paired with a monochrome fit (like with the matching jacket, a cream-colored t-shirt, and tan sneakers), but also works with just about any color in my closet. My only gripe? This short runs a little long on me, which takes away some of that fast feel I want in a running short. I might get it hemmed just to hit the perfect length—but that’s an easy fix for a pair that ticks so many other boxes. Whether I’m running laps or running errands, it strikes the perfect balance between performance-grade gear and streetwear cool. Shannen Zitz Shannen wearing the Track Short in Cream, styled with the Track Jacket and Cloudzone Moon. On x Zendaya Track Jacket Review On Track Jacket $180 at on.com Credit: On Pros Roomy, boxy fit Lightweight and breathable Clean, streamlined look Cons Not super warm Like the track short, its matching jacket is feather light and slightly boxy for an effortless vibe. The material feels premium, and the construction is top-tier with zippers that blend right into the fabric and a slightly funnel-shaped collar that looks super chic when zipped all the way shut. It’s the kind of jacket that instantly pulls a look together, even if you’re just layering it over a tank top and leggings. Just don’t expect it to be your warmest layer. It’s designed for movement, not warmth, which makes it ideal for toasty fall afternoons or warming up before a workout. Still, it’s so stylish and versatile that I wear it under my winter coat when temps drop. If Zendaya’s goal was to make performance wear that belongs both in the gym and on the street, this jacket might be the collection's ultimate proof. Shannen Zitz Track Jacket The Final Verdict: Should You Shop The Collection? After testing the On x Zendaya collection , I get the hype. You can totally tell that this collection was designed with the help of Zendaya and stylist Law Roach. It’s a rare activewear line that feels both high-fashion and high-performance. The materials and construction live up to On’s technical reputation, while Zendaya’s style shines through in the line’s sleek silhouettes and flattering color schemes. I love wearing these pieces while I’m breaking a sweat, and feel just as comfortable meeting up for a post-workout lunch without bringing a change of clothes. If you’re after gear that performs as well as it photographs, this collection can’t be missed. The close bond between Euphoria stars Sydney Sweeney and Zendaya appears to be under strain, with reports suggesting the two actresses are at odds over fundamental political differences. What was once a warm on-set friendship has grown noticeably distant, sources say, as the cast prepares for promotional work surrounding the show’s highly anticipated third season. The rift centers on contrasting political viewpoints rather than any personal conflict. Sweeney, 28, has openly identified as a Republican and vocal supporter of President Donald Trump, while Zendaya, 29, has consistently opposed Trump’s political positions. The ideological gap between the two has created an awkward dynamic as they face the prospect of appearing together for press appearances and red carpet events tied to Euphoria’s next chapter. The advertising controversy The tension intensified following Sweeney’s appearance in an American Eagle jeans campaign that drew swift backlash on social media. Critics alleged the advertisement contained a racist undertone through a wordplay pun linking jeans with genes. The ad featured a line reading Sydney Sweeney has great jeans, which observers interpreted as a clever double meaning that some deemed offensive and inappropriate. When confronted about the controversial campaign, Sweeney declined to apologize for her participation or the ad’s messaging. In an interview with GQ, the actress maintained that she was fully aware of the implications surrounding the project. She stated that the advertisement spoke for itself and that the social media reaction caught her off guard. Sweeney suggested that when she chooses to address issues directly, her voice will be heard through deliberate statements rather than responses to criticism. Growing distance for season three The political and advertising-related tensions have created complications for Euphoria’s upcoming promotional cycle. Reports indicate that Zendaya has been reluctant to participate in joint press obligations with Sweeney, particularly those involving red carpet appearances or shared interviews. This development carries significant implications for HBO’s marketing strategy surrounding the show’s third season, which wrapped production several weeks ago. Sources familiar with the situation explained that the dynamic puts Zendaya in a difficult position. Being photographed alongside Sweeney on the red carpet could be interpreted by observers and media as tacit endorsement of Sweeney’s political views or her refusal to address the American Eagle advertisement controversy. Matt Damon stars as Odysseus in this fantasy-action reimagining of Homer\'s epic. The star-studded cast, including Anne Hathaway and Tom Holland, promises a grand cinematic spectacle as Odysseus battles monsters and fate on his journey home after the Trojan War. Christopher Nolan only needs a whisper to set the internet vibrating, but the first look at The Odyssey has pushed that buzz into full-blown frenzy. The images, our first glimpse of Robert Pattinson , Zendaya , and John Leguizamo in character, dropped via Empire and instantly lit up social feeds. The director is reimagining Homer’s epic as a fantasy-action odyssey, a scale he’s more than comfortable with, with Matt Damon leading the charge as Odysseus, the war-worn king of Ithaca fighting his way back home. But the new images belong to Pattinson, Zendaya, and Leguizamo, who each take on roles woven deep into the mythology. Pattinson appears as Antinous, the powerful suitor vying for Penelope in Odysseus’s absence. Zendaya steps into the divine as Athena, the goddess of wisdom and war. And Leguizamo plays Eumaeus, the steadfast servant who becomes one of Odysseus’s most loyal allies. And it doesn’t stop there. The cast list reads like a cross-section of Hollywood heavyweights: Tom Holland as Telemachus, Anne Hathaway as Penelope, Charlize Theron as Circe, Benny Safdie as Agamemnon, Lupita Nyong’o as Clytemnestra. Add Elliot Page, Mia Goth, Corey Hawkins, Jon Bernthal, Cosmo Jarvis, Himesh Patel, Samantha Morton, Will Yun Lee, Logan Marshall-Green, James Remar, and more, and it becomes clear Nolan is assembling something closer to a cinematic army than a simple ensemble. Universal’s official synopsis keeps it classic: Odysseus’ long journey home after the Trojan War, marked by monsters, temptations, and the raw brutality of fate.
